statement.zh: Sandweiss 等 2009：地震、厄尔尼诺洪水、滩脊与沙丘入侵约 3800–3600 cal B.P. 导致早期苏佩聚落废弃——环境单因/突变叙事属开放假说。
statement.en: Sandweiss et al. 2009: earthquakes, El Niño floods, beach ridges, and dune incursion ~3800–3600 cal B.P. caused early Supe abandonment—single-cause/abrupt environmental narrative remains an open hypothesis.

disclaimer: This record is a HYPOTHESIS / contested scholarly reading, not an established archaeological conclusion. Do not treat as fact.
